text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Rose
Kingdom—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
After this,
I intend to attend the reception party.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a new restaurant opened by a chef
close to our clan.
I wish to pay my respects.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Oh—
So you two came as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Our families have shared close ties for
generations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for me.
Back during my father's racing career,
a member of this very house accompanied him
abroad as his personal chef.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Just as expected of a clan leading the
culinary world.

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for gathering here
today!
And now—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Is it time to begin?
Come then, Trainer,
let us take our seats as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every dish brought to the table was naturally
exquisite,
and each course offered a delightful
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Trainer, was the meal to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Every single dish was exquisitely refined.

text_block_list.name: Invited Guests
text_block_list.text:
“That was an exquisite dish.”
“With this,
even our clan's dream of three stars is
within—”
“I can hardly wait for the grand opening.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It seems to be quite well received.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Every single dish was fierce.
...To the point of chilling intensity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite their words,
all three seemed hesitant and evasive.
Just then,
the chef approached to greet them.

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
At my new restaurant,
I am aiming for the pinnacle...
to earn the three stars that have long been
my clan's cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text:
Could I perhaps ask for your frank and honest
thoughts as well,
as fellow runners striving for the pinnacle
of the racing world?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The dishes were all truly splendid.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It felt so tense...
as if the thread could snap at any second.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
One can only imagine the weight of that
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that is what it means to bear the clan's
name.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you seek to present a dignified front,
I believe it is equally vital not to let
your struggle show.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, your own family must also have
a legacy built across generations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If so,
the talent already resides within you—
all that remains is to dedicate yourself
and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text:
—It is just as you say.
Weighed down by the heavy burden of my clan's
long-cherished dream... I...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yet, would today not be the perfect
opportunity, then?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Gathered here are those who believe in you
and your house,
who stand ready to support you—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If you go around to meet them in person,
you are bound to realize just how precious
and endearing their sentiments are.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And those feelings, I believe,
will one day
turn that heavy burden into pride.

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text: Turning that crushing weight into pride...

text_block_list.name: Male Chef
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I shall go once more to gather their
thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chef offered his thanks once more,
then hurriedly made his way over toward the
other invited guests.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—well now, Trainer.
Shall we take our leave as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —On the way back.
choice_data_list: Did you have a fulfilling break?
That was quite a star-studded line...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was a most fruitful time. I,
too,
must dedicate myself to meeting everyone's
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Could you spare me a little more time?
I wish to discuss our training plans.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Starting tomorrow,
let us hone ourselves once more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So that the magnificent Rose Kingdom
may shine brightly for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Particularly Ruby and Duramente,
who, like myself,
run bearing the hopes of their bloodlines.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Catching a glimpse of what the clan meant
to both of them
was a stroke of good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Heh,
I cannot afford to be outdone either.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer.
Starting tomorrow,
let us devote ourselves even further.
